article_title: Major human schistosome species express different glycans with immunological and diagnostic implications
method_summary: MALDI-TOF-MS source peak lists. AA-labeled GSL and N glycans were measured in negative mode; reduced permethylated O-glycans in positive mode. The Methods describe 300 ppm initial composition assignment, manual curation, and follow-up structural characterization of selected ions. No sample-level retention-time/structure crosswalk accompanies the 32 peak lists.
